# The Phenomenon of Life

*[Hans Jonas](../philosophers/jonas.md) · 1966 · *The Phenomenon of Life: Toward a Philosophical Biology**

A collection of essays published in English in 1966 (German version in 1973), in which [Jonas](../philosophers/jonas.md) works out a "philosophical biology": he reads in [metabolism](../glossary/metabolism.md) a first freedom and purposiveness, challenges cybernetics and sees in existentialism a new dualism, akin to ancient Gnosticism.
